subject: inorganic
question:
无机化学·配位化学：请判断下列配合物的几何构型：Tungsten hexachloride（WCl₆）？
A. Octahedral
B. Trigonal prismatic
C. Linear
D. Trigonal planar
explanation: Octahedral. Covalent count: W (group 6) 6 e; 6 × Cl (X) 6 e: 12 e. Ionic count: the ligands carry a charge of −6 in all and the complex is neutral, so the metal is W(VI), d⁰; d⁰ + 12 e from the ligands = 12 e.
